Ew Hi, Joseph. ® You know how our store does those
workshops on home improvements? Well, Ol'm
supposed to lead one next month, but it turns out
have to go out of town.
IM Well, ®I could do it for you. Ol'm finishing up a series
of workshops on bathroom remodeling this month,
so I'll have more time then. What's the topic of the
workshop?
Kw It's about how to install light fixtures in your home. A lot
of our customers are interested in that.
m OK, sure. But I haven't done that kind of workshop
before. I'm not sure what materials I'll need.
Ekw Don't worry. I'll get all the materials ready so you'll
have them beforehand.
